scope: Float64 reference contract and installed-source review only; no native engine or force-producing execution.

record_conventions.edge: (v0,v1,-1), two simplex weights and zero padding
record_conventions.face: three distinct corners and simplex weights
record_conventions.rigid_point: Raw uninflated surface point in rigid BODY local frame, incorporating shape-to-body transform
record_conventions.normal: World-frame rigid outward face normal for reference fixtures only
record_conventions.body_velocity: Raw surface velocity in body frame
record_conventions.reference_penetration: -projected_gap + max(active corner radii) + shape margin, each once

reference_checks: finite nonnegative normalized barycentric weights and valid padding
surface points/normal directions/rigid and soft frames
single application of radii and margins
exact event equivalence only; different supports retained
raw overflow before reduction; dynamic adjacency capacity
intersection-only witnesses not promoted to signed force contacts
kinematic_observer_finding: Installed build_body_particle_contact_lists skips bodies whose effective inverse mass is <=0; existing observer reads that list. Prescribed blade reactions therefore require a global-stream collector or another validated route. Source-level concern, not a measured positive-contact failure; prior zero-contact results do not resolve it.
duplicate_scope: Reference preview only. No native records or solver force accumulation were reduced or changed.
numeric_policy: 1e-12 absolute arithmetic checks apply to float64 synthetic fixtures only. No physical acceptance threshold or native float32 conversion budget was set.
remaining_gates: signed-contact normal and penetration definitions for actual mesh overlaps and ambiguous intersections
native dtype conversion, serialization and owned live-state bindings
full-stream kinematic reaction collector and dynamic/kinematic runtime controls
contact record reset/history/capacity and duplicate manifold policy
positive-contact independent force, work and energy audits
